full_name: Arjun Dey | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Arjun Dey is an astronomer at the National Optical Astronomy Observatory, where he studies how galaxies form and evolve and how they trace the large-scale distribution of matter in the universe. He aims to apply massively multiplexed spectroscopic capabilities to the solution of major astrophysical mysteries, such as our cosmological origins and the nature of dark energy.
